svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Laser cut 92 x 144 mm, 15 mm corner radius, from 4 mm steel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bearing bore 44 mm: 40 mm from the back edge, 72 mm from the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bearing bolt holes 13 mm, 49.5 mm above and below the bore centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The back edge faces the stair; the front edge faces the load.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: weld it to the inside face of the left rail, its bore centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm behind the rail centre line and 142.5 mm above the toe plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fillet weld both sides along the rail, 150 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld it with the outer case plate on a straight 25 mm bar through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: both bores, so the two bores line up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 25 mm flange bearing bolts to its inside face with two M12

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolts, nyloc nuts on the outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bar turns freely in both bores after welding.
